label: Cebu
short_description: Metro Cebu hotels from Mandaue City to the Mactan island beach resorts near the airport.
intro: Cebu's hotels in this directory spread across Metro Cebu in the central Philippines: the urban Mandaue City area on the main island, and Mactan island to the east -- home to the beach resorts and, at its northern tip, Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB). City hotels suit business and stopovers; the Mactan resorts suit beach stays, with the two linked by bridges across the channel.
